scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run check -w worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w web && npm run deploy -w worker
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build -w web && cd web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && npm run cf:render && npx wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.mobile:open: cd web && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:apk:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd web/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
